description: The Ethir Neechal family continues where it left off. Janani & her co-sisters are breaking down barriers to carve out their space in an exciting & empowering journey as they strive to earn their family's understanding and protect relationships. Be the first to watch your favourite serial, Ethirneechal Thodargirathu – early access only on Sun NXT.

Experience a unique cooking show packed with chef-inspired dishes, medicinal recipes, village-style cooking, and celebrity guests, all woven into exciting and unique weekly themes — with opportunities for viewers to participate too.
